data.name: A staff email mitigates all matching earlier submissions within this window (1–30 days). Later submissions require a new follow-up.

Comma-separated staff email addresses or @domains. This filter does not authenticate senders; restrict mailbox delivery on the mail server.

data.name: Dedicated mailbox included in your staff CC group, or explicitly copied on customer replies.

data.name: IMAP folder to inspect. Messages are never marked as read, moved or deleted.

data.name: IMAP hostname. Implicit TLS and valid server certificates are required.

data.name: Mailbox password or application password. No mail server administrator credentials are needed.
data.value: Lösenord till brevlådan eller applikationslösenord. Inga administratörsuppgifter för e-postservern behövs.

data.name: Read a dedicated IMAPS mailbox receiving staff follow-up copies. The mail server must restrict delivery to authenticated internal staff. Requires AlertCenter integration.
data.value: Läs en separat IMAPS-brevlåda som tar emot kopior av personalens uppföljningsmeddelanden. E-postservern måste begränsa leveransen till autentiserad intern personal. Kräver integration med AlertCenter.

data.name: Send new contact submissions to AlertCenter as sev2 incidents. Disabling pauses delivery; pending submissions are retained.
